text:
marta: Heads-up — PR gating GH Actions for evals started spamming duplicate artifact uploads and the metrics in the eval-dashboard are showing quantized runs under the wrong model tag. Noticed after the new matrix for quantization presets landed. Anyone seen this?

jake: I saw one flaky run earlier where two runners tried to upload the same shard at once. GH log showed a 409 on the artifact upload, then a retry that succeeded but with a different run_id. Could that be the root cause of duplicates in the dashboard?

ci-bot: [automated] workflow CI-evals-pr-gate #482 failed to upload artifact shard-7.tar.gz (http 409). Retrying...

ravi: 409 typically means concurrent uploads with same name. We used to add the run id in the filename to avoid collisions. New matrix expands names, maybe a race. Can you paste the upload step?

marta: Here's the relevant part of the GH actions step we currently use:

```yaml
- name: Upload eval shard
  uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
  with:
    name: shard-${{ matrix.shard_index }}.tar.gz
    path: ./artifacts/shard-${{ matrix.shard_index }}.tar.gz
```

marta: That name is identical across parallel jobs for the same PR, so yeah, collisions possible.

jake: Quick fix: include `github.run_id` and `github.job` or `matrix` fields in the name. Example: `name: shard-${{ matrix.shard_index }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ matrix.quant }}.tar.gz`. That makes artifact names unique per run.

qa-bot: Suggest also adding an `artifact-checksum` step so the dashboard ingest can ignore duplicates with identical hashes. Small script: `sha256sum shard-*.tar.gz > checksums.txt` and upload that too.

marta: Good call. That would help the ingest lambda dedupe logic. Also the dashboard mapping problem: quantized runs appearing under base model label. I traced it to our eval metadata file. When quantization preset is present, the `model_tag` field sometimes gets overwritten by the onboarding script.

sylvia: Oof. Which file? The eval-metadata JSON generated by the runner?

marta: Yes. Example snippet from a problematic metadata: 

```json
{"model": "redwood/7b-open", "quant": "int8-ldq", "model_tag": "redwood/7b-open", "commit": "abc123"}
```

marta: The `model_tag` should include quant suffix like `redwood/7b-open@int8-ldq` so the dashboard treats it as a distinct series. The runner-side code that mutates metadata loses `quant` under some matrix branches.

ravi: I can add a safeguard in the metadata writer: if `quant` exists and `@` not in `model_tag`, append `@${quant}`. Small change.

jake: Also think about the CI wiring: GH Actions has limited matrix concurrency for our repo. Two problems: (1) duplicate artifact names causing 409s, (2) the runner sometimes replays a job when a self-hosted runner checks in late which results in a second upload under a new run_id. We should set `concurrency` to cancel-in-progress duplicates:

```yaml
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.ref }}-${{ matrix.job_group }}-${{ github.head_ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
```

marta: That would prevent multiple simultaneous matrices for the same PR ref, good idea.

sylvia: On the dashboard side I'll add a mapping change: treat `model_tag` as canonical series id. If `quant` is present but not in `model_tag`, also index under the derived tag and show a tooltip explaining the auto-appended quant. That should fix the splits.

qa-bot: Ops note: nightly scheduled runs also collided with PR-run matrix earlier this week — two runs wrote the same time-series labels to the metrics bucket. Recommend setting a `run_type` label (pr/nightly) in the metrics emitter. Easy change: `labels.run_type = is_pr ? "pr" : "nightly"`.

marta: Agreed. Plan of action: (1) Jake to update upload artifact name and add concurrency block in GH workflow, (2) Ravi to patch metadata writer to append quant tag, (3) QA to add checksum step, (4) Sylvia to update dashboard indexing for model_tag + run_type, (5) I'll run a smoke PR with reduced matrix and watch the next nightly.

jake: I'll open PR with the GH changes in 10m, include sample artifact names and a smoke workflow that runs only two matrix entries.

ravi: I'll open a tiny patch for metadata writer and add unit test that asserts model_tag contains quant when quant present.

sylvia: I'll version the dashboard mapping change and add a migration that backfills tags for the last 7 days.

ci-bot: [automated] CI-evals-pr-gate #483 started for commit def456 (marta).

marta: Thanks all. If anyone notices additional weirdness in the ingestion logs, ping me. I'll watch the bucket for duplicate objects and the eval-dashboard for missing quant series. :eyes:

jake: quick note — adding `github.run_id` inflates artifact storage count in some scripts; we'll make the dedupe logic rely on checksum instead of artifact name when reconciling historical runs.

qa-bot: Filing a short postmortem draft in #postmortems after we confirm root cause and fixes.

marta: Perfect. Closing on this thread once PRs merged and nightly is green.
